Taurus Engineering Inc. designs and manufactures oilfield equipment. Our Long Beach team builds precision equipment used in demanding field environments, and we depend on a reliable supply chain to keep production on schedule.

--------------------

The Purchasing Assistant supports the Purchasing department in buying materials, components, and services for manufacturing operations.
